text:
**Rischi espliciti:**
1. **Dipendenza critica:** Tutte le pratiche (P10-000–009) bloccate sulla disponibilità del "disegno aggiornato".
2. **Stato operativo:** Pratiche sospese (P10-001, 005, 009) e in revisione (P10-002, 006) non avanzano.
3. **Incertezza temporale:** Scadenza indefinita per P10-006.
4. **Vincolo budgetario:** Importi preventivi, non consuntivi; nessuna anticipazione approvata.

**Inferenze:**
1. **Collo di bottiglia:** Un singolo input (disegno) paralizza l'intero portafoglio, creando rischio di ritardo sistemico.
2. **Rischio finanziario:** Budget elevati (es. P10-005: 7618€) su pratiche sospese indicano capitale immobilizzato senza avanzamento.
3. **Gestione inefficace:** La mancata approvazione dell'anticipo scadenze suggerisce rigidità nei processi o mancanza di risorse per accelerare la produzione dei disegni.<|im_end|>

Extract issues and dependencies from the document, distinguishing explicit risks from possible inferences.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Nadia, responsible for the building services department, reports case P10-000, status approved, budget 2363 euros, deadline 2026-11-11. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Paolo, responsible for the structures department, reports case P10-001, status suspended, budget 377 euros, deadline 2026-11-12. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Rita, responsible for the construction department, reports case P10-002, status under review, budget 1875 euros, deadline 2026-11-13. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P10-003, status approved, budget 4478 euros, deadline 2026-11-14. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Tommaso, responsible for the structures department, reports case P10-004, status approved, budget 6160 euros, deadline 2026-11-15. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Anna, responsible for the construction department, reports case P10-005, status suspended, budget 7618 euros, deadline 2026-11-16. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P10-006, status under review, budget 3883 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P10-007, status approved, budget 3933 euros, deadline 2026-11-18. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Diego, responsible for the construction department, reports case P10-008, status approved, budget 2643 euros, deadline 2026-11-19. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P10-009, status suspended, budget 4255 euros, deadline 2026-11-20. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.

answer_en:
**Explicit risks:**
1. **Critical Dependency:** All practices (P10-000–009) stuck on “updated drawing” availability.
2. **Operational status:** Suspended (P10-001, 005, 009) and under review (P10-002, 006) cases are not progressing.
3. **Timing Uncertainty:** Indefinite expiration for P10-006.
4. **Budgetary constraint:** Estimated, not actual amounts; no advance approved.

**Inferences:**
1. **Bottleneck:** A single input (drawing) paralyzes the entire portfolio, creating systemic delay risk.
2. **Financial risk:** High budgets (e.g. P10-005: 7618€) on suspended practices indicate capital tied up without progress.
3. **Ineffective management:** Failure to approve advance deadlines suggests rigidity in processes or lack of resources to accelerate drawing production.<|im_end|>
